description: Get detailed status, configuration, and live performance for a specific trading bot by ID. Returns its run status, the strategy/symbol/exchange it trades, whether it is paper or live, P&L, win rate, total trades, risk config (leverage, stop-loss, take-profit, position size) and, for a strategy bot, strategyConfig (version channel and the version it runs, preset, timeframe, execution mode, interval, parameter overrides: what update_bot can change). Use it to check how a deployed bot is doing. stopAfterClose.enabled = true means the bot will pause itself once its current position closes (set with update_bot); completedAt is when it last did. Read-only — to stop a bot use stop_bot or update_bot stopAfterClose. Get bot IDs from list_bots.

id.description: The bot ID to inspect, obtained from list_bots.

name: get_bot_status
